summary: All ten assigned contact sheets were visually inspected, representing 120 forward/reverse station pairs (indices432–551). Roadside cuts and banks need A contact and macroform treatment; broad readable upper cliff/valley/plateau faces support B independently of the C coast/skyline context. Sheets036 and038 show particularly strong B face evidence; 040–041 alternate open coast with reverse valley faces; 044–045 expose a wide upland escarpment. Image-scale contact review cannot establish world-surface identity, occluded D zones, confirmed background simplification, material classes or geometry-defect causes. Dark road patches/abrupt ends warrant original inspection only. Canonical tags remain blank, owner review pending. Panorama presence denotes a separately visible distant/coastal terrain region; where only the outline of the same broad B face or sea alone is visible, C is uncertain. Near sides denote raised cut/bank shapes, not flat shoulders.
